# Ilya Drigo

> Ilya Drigo (Илья Дриго) is a meteorologist and physical oceanographer. Client Solutions Lead at OpenWeather since 2026. Previously Senior Research Meteorologist at Yandex Weather (2021-2025) and Meteorology Research Lead at Windy.app (2019-2021). Works on weather forecasting, climate risk and ocean modelling for business clients.

Contact: ilya.drigo@gmail.com · Telegram @idrigo (https://t.me/idrigo) · LinkedIn https://linkedin.com/in/ilya-drigo/ · GitHub https://github.com/idrigo · Google Scholar https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=tCIJt7YAAAAJ

## Experience

- 2026-present: Client Solutions Lead, OpenWeather (remote).
- 2025-2026: Independent consultant and researcher. CMIP6 climate-risk model (team lead), probabilistic forecasting pipeline on ECMWF AIFS, ML wind forecast tool for sailors, physical oceanographer on the AI-71 Atlantic cruise.
- 2021-2025: Senior Research Meteorologist, Yandex Weather (Meteum). Technical lead on 50+ B2B projects; $200K+ revenue from ten climate-risk deals; precipitation nowcasting launch (+20% ARPU in exposed cohorts); WRF hail hindcasting for insurance; +23% urban forecast accuracy.
- 2019-2021: Meteorology Research Lead, Windy.app. 15+ B2B forecasting solutions for wind and solar generation; radar nowcasting (75% POD at 10 min); operational WRF for coastal Europe and Japan; weather routing.
- 2018-2019: Research Assistant, ITMO University. NEMO sea-ice model coupled with deep learning; ice-thickness RMSE reduced by 19%.
- 2017-2018: Hydrometeorology Engineer, Marine Research Center, Moscow State University. Physical oceanography on three expeditions.

## Education

- M.Sc. Applied and Computational Mathematics (Big Data & ML), ITMO University, 2020.
- B.Sc. Hydrometeorology (Oceanography), Lomonosov Moscow State University, with honours, 2018.

## Expertise

Numerical weather prediction (WRF, MPAS), ocean models (NEMO, SHYFEM), AI weather models (ECMWF AIFS, GraphCast, Pangu-Weather), ensemble and probabilistic forecasting, forecast verification, radar nowcasting, CMIP6 climate risk, bias correction and downscaling, Python, PyTorch, xarray, Dask, HPC.

## Projects and publications

- [Ocean Peaks](https://maola.org/): sailing expedition studying seamounts and ocean eddies from the yacht MAOLA; website built by Ilya.
- [Climate Insight at Meteum](https://b2b.meteum.ai/blog/posts/how-meteums-climate-insight-helps-businesses-adapt-to-climate-risks): CMIP6 climate-risk pipeline.
- [Seasonal forecasts with machine learning](https://b2b.meteum.ai/blog/posts/how-meteum-uses-machine-learning-to-create-seasonal-forecasts)
- [Arctic sea-ice data-driven modelling](https://github.com/idrigo/arctic_ddmodeling): open-source code.
- [How the weather in Russia changed since the 1940s](https://yandex.ru/company/researches/2024/weather-change) (Yandex, 2024, in Russian)
- [Weather at the World Cup](https://yandex.ru/company/researches/2022/football-weather) (Yandex, 2022, in Russian)
